description: Land Title Settlement Department - Harakgalegama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511200
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, owner details, and property characteristics) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
